events.did: 沉坐到后座长椅上，Mitch 和 Syd 爬进前排
events.quote_anchor: Victor sank onto the bench beside him, as Mitch and Syd climbed into the front.

events.did: 转动旋钮把胸痛压下去，随后摇下车窗让冷风拂过皮肤
events.quote_anchor: He turned the dials until it didn’t really bother him. Then rolled the window down and let the cold air slide over his skin.

events.did: 从后视镜里对上 Victor 的视线，问他有没有事
events.quote_anchor: “You okay, Vic?” asked Mitch, meeting his gaze in the rearview mirror.

events.did: 把手抚过 Dol 的毛，感觉到那条狗在长凳上轻轻甩尾
events.quote_anchor: Victor hummed in agreement. He slid his hand across Dol’s fur, and felt the dog stir, his tail thudding softly on the bench.

events.did: 低声说了句“好狗”并让眼睛闭上
events.quote_anchor: “Good dog,” he murmured, letting his eyes fall closed.

events.did: 没有挣扎，只是听着他们的声音，直到黑暗像黑色马克笔一样盖住视线
events.quote_anchor: He didn’t fight. Just listened to their voices, until the darkness slid across his vision like a thick black marker, blotting out the end.

events.did: 在前排问他们这是要去哪里
events.quote_anchor: “Where are we going?” Syd was asking now, up front.

events.did: 回想自己每一次与死亡搏斗都赢了
events.quote_anchor: Every time so far, he had fought death, and won.

relations.did: 把 Dol 带在身边，在车上抚摸它的毛
relations.quote_anchor: He slid his hand across Dol’s fur, and felt the dog stir, his tail thudding softly on the bench.

relations.did: 曾在墓地里把他从死亡中拖回来
relations.quote_anchor: In the graveyard, when Sydney hauled him back.

relations.did: 在 Falcon Price 把刀捅进他的肋骨之间
relations.quote_anchor: In the Falcon Price, when Eli drove a knife between his ribs.

relations.did: 有了新的能力，眼睛仍是原来那双温暖的棕色
relations.quote_anchor: His eyes were the same warm brown they’d always been, despite his new abilities.

numbers.did: 心脏曾停止跳动“一百次”，地点是“一百个不同的地方”
numbers.quote_anchor: A hundred times in a hundred different places, when his heart stopped in his chest again and again and again.

numbers.did: 在公寓里举起酒杯时对 Eli 说自己先来（go first）
numbers.quote_anchor: In the apartment, when he lifted his glass to Eli and offered to go first.

numbers.did: 心脏一次又一次地（again and again and again）停止跳动
numbers.quote_anchor: when his heart stopped in his chest again and again and again.
